DISC, as well as the GIN - are very novel and interesting topics that are of huge concern. It is a very important part of history, and chances are slim that it would be written as such, or that such writing would occupy a significant place, if these forces ultimately win, which we believe they would not.

The making and the ingredients of these things have been around since the beginning of time.

I am trying to figure out how it works.

Innovation, creativity, exploration, comes naturally to me. I am by nature a patriot and a pioneer.

I love to be able to see the big picture and where things originated from, how it works, what it's first principles are, how it fits into the greater puzzle.

So I could not help but to try and understand the dynamics of hierarchy and power in our world.

49 Years old, I have come to the conclusion that there are amongst other two things that stand out: The Abramic History, and the Occult History.

That has implications of how you are going to view the world, physics, time, space, spirit and mind, logic, cell and atom.
